scope: Historical native Node SQLite measurements; not a fresh qualification of the current Bun branch

workload.data: Highly compressible synthetic text and JSON, with row-specific prefixes and no Auth rows
workload.target: Local in-memory PGlite; no hosted target

result.dataVerified: Direct cases preserved source data and matched target rows/checksums
result.firstWriteLimit: COUNT queries had already visited each source table
result.largeWorkload128MiBOldSpace: All four stock invocations exhausted the heap; all four direct invocations completed
result.memoryLimit: V8 old-space is not total heap, RSS or deployment RAM; process RSS remained roughly 1.0–1.4 GiB
result.timingLimit: One observation per case, stock observed earlier, uncontrolled warm caches; no speed or billing conclusion
result.largeWorkload1024MiBOldSpace: Both stock and direct completed; direct CLI and apply timings were slower in these single observations

currentBunChecks.limit: Bun uses the existing materializing path; these checks do not requalify native streaming

reproduction.limit: Benchmark requires actual Node with native node:sqlite and pinned PGlite 0.4.5; the retained scripts generate new observations, not the historical hashes
